title: Battery Critically Low During Enrollment
description: Detects that the device's battery dropped to 15% or less while enrolling on battery power (power_state_change threshold event from the agent's live power watcher). A device dying mid-enrollment leaves a half-provisioned state that typically needs a full reset; this rule surfaces the risk while there is still time to plug the device in. Uses a single required condition on the agent-stamped thresholdPercent field (the data field 'transition' on the event is unrelated to this rule's 'trigger' property).
explanation: The device's battery fell below **{{thresholdPercent}}%** while the enrollment was running on battery power. If the battery drains completely mid-enrollment, the device is left in a half-provisioned state — apps, policies, or the user profile may be incomplete, and in most cases the device has to be reset and re-enrolled. The agent detected the threshold crossing live via a Windows power-status notification; the exact percentage at that moment is recorded on the matched power_state_change event in the session timeline.

remediation.title: Secure power for the running enrollment
steps: Connect the device to AC power immediately — the enrollment continues normally once power is stable.
If the device shut down before completing, check whether the session reached the desktop; if not, reset the device (Autopilot reset or reimage) and re-enroll it plugged in.
For technician/White Glove flows, make AC power part of the bench checklist — pre-provisioning on battery is the most common source of this alert.
If this fires across many devices of one model, review that model's battery health (the hardware_spec event carries design vs. full-charge capacity).
